answer_2.quote: Regression on STS datasets (Soft-STS-15 and STS-B) is measured using Spearman´s rank correlation ... The average prediction error ... is captured by the root mean squared error (RMSE). For soft evaluation, we rely on a metric aimed at ordinal quantification, Earth-Mover's Distance (EMD) ... we refer to this distance-aware EMD as δ-EMD.
